card.name: Per-day wording in dose limits
card.fires_on: The time-unit word that completes a dose rate or limit, such as day in 'per day' or 'a day', daily after 'maximum', and hour in '24-hour period'. It also fires on 'time' in 'at any one time'.

modes.label: Daily after maximum
modes.description: The word daily right after 'maximum' before dose or dosage.

modes.label: Per day or a day
modes.description: The word day ending a rate such as 'per day' or 'a day'.
modes.example: at a dose exceeding 300 mg per<< day>>.

modes.label: 24-hour period
modes.description: The word hour in a '24-hour period' limit.
modes.example: The maximum recommended dosage in a 24<<-hour>> period is 2 tablets

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that close a count or limit phrase, such as 'twice' and 'already', and away from 'immediately' words.
card.plain: It lights up on the time word that finishes a dose limit, like 'per day' or 'in 24 hours'.
